</div></div><div class="w-separator size_small with_line style_solid color_border width_default align_center"><div class="w-separator-h"></div></div><div class="wpb_text_column"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><h3>Description</h3>
</div></div><div class="w-post-elm post_custom_field us_custom_7709e774 guesty-location type_text property_size color_link_inherit"><span class="w-post-elm-before">Property Size: </span><span class="w-post-elm-value">2,928 sq ft / 272 m²</span></div><div class="w-post-elm post_custom_field us_custom_4f24afa8 type_text summary color_link_inherit"><p>Windchaser Villas are the epitome of Caribbean living, blending understated luxury with fantastic facilities and a beautiful location. </p>
<p>The development is comprised of 10 properties of which 3 are part of our vacation rental program and all other properties are private residences.</p>
<p>Bora Villa is a modern 4-bedroom property in the development with a private pool, tropical gardens, and direct access via a private pathway to the white sands and crystal-clear waters of Long Bay Beach. </p>
</div><div class="w-tabs us_custom_4e1ed02b accordion type_togglable toggle_style_1 has_scrolling remove_indents" style="--sections-title-size:inherit;--sections-gap:0.5rem;"><div class="w-tabs-sections titles-align_none icon_chevron cpos_right"><div class="w-tabs-section" id="f5fb"><button type="button" class="w-tabs-section-header" aria-controls="content-f5fb" aria-expanded="false"><div class="w-tabs-section-title">The Space</div><div class="w-tabs-section-control"></div></button><div  class="w-tabs-section-content" id="content-f5fb"><div class="w-tabs-section-content-h i-cf"><div class="wpb_text_column"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><h3>The Space</h3>
</div></div><div class="w-post-elm post_content us_custom_92b2762d property-listing with_collapsible_content" itemprop="text" data-content-height="300px"><div><p>All villas have air conditioning throughout, including the four beautiful bedrooms.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Bedroom 1:</strong> King bed, air-conditioning, pool/garden view</li>
<li><strong>Bedroom 2:</strong> King bed or two twin beds, air conditioning, pool/garden view</li>
<li><strong>Bedroom 3:</strong> King bed or two twin beds, air conditioning, pool/garden view, attached private suite with kitchen</li>
<li><strong>Bedroom 4:</strong> King bed or two twin beds, air conditioning, pool/garden view, attached private suite with kitchen</li>
<li>There are three pull-out couches providing a supplementary sleeping option for children under 12 years old</li>
</ul>
<p>The property also has 2 side suites above the garden view bedrooms providing additional living/office space or an additional sofa bedroom.</p>
<p>In addition, the guest has access to the shared tennis court in the development.</p>
<h3>UPGRADE YOUR STAY</h3>
<p><span>Our Concierge team is here to make your stay effortless and memorable. We would be happy to assist with arrangements such as:</span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Pre-stocking grocery service</span></li>
<li><span>Transportation</span></li>
<li><span>Private chef</span></li>
<li><span>Butler services</span></li>
<li><span>Housekeeping</span></li>
<li><span>Excursions, activities, and restaurant reservations</span></li>
<li><span>Spa and wellness</span></li>
<li><span>Special requests</span></li>
</ul>
<p>Please <a href="/contact/">contact us</a> <span>to request details of the service of interest, and we’ll be delighted to organize everything for you.</span><span></span></p>
<h3>HOUSE RULES</h3>
<ul>
<li>No smoking</li>
<li>No pets</li>
<li>No parties or events</li>
<li><span role="presentation">Check- in 4:00 PM (For early check-in requests, please let us know in advance, and we will do our best to accommodate)</span></li>
<li>
<div role="presentation"><span>Check-out by 11:00 AM (For late check out requests, please let us know in advance, and we will do our best to accommodate)</span></div>
</li>
</ul>
<h3>TKCA VACATION RENTALS VIA TRUVI</h3>
<ul>
<li>We are committed to protecting our properties, which is why we&#8217;ve partnered with Know Your Guest, the leading vacation rental guest-screening provider.</li>
<li>Please note that before your booking begins, you will need to verify your details through Know Your Guest.</li>
<li>A non-refundable damage waiver amounting to $210 is required. This protects you if there is accidental damage of up to $3,000 to the property during the stay.</li>
</ul>
<h3>UTILITIES</h3>
<ul>
<li>The cost of electricity in the Turks &amp; Caicos Islands has always been very expensive. This is further exacerbated by recent global increases in fuel pricing which have put this cost at an all-time high.</li>
<li>All guests are asked to be mindful of their energy consumption and particularly as it relates to Air Conditioning (AC). If you are running the AC, please ensure doors and windows remain closed.</li>
<li>The owner of your vacation rental will cover up to $60.00/day (sixty US Dollars) for electricity consumption. On the last day of this rental, the meter will be read, and any amount over this allowance will be charged to the lessee&#8217;s card on file at a rate of $0.60 per KWH.</li>
</ul>

</div></div><div class="w-post-elm post_custom_field type_text notes color_link_inherit"><p>Beach and Shoreline Conditions</p>
<p>As with all Caribbean beaches, shoreline conditions may vary throughout the year. Seasonal sargassum seaweed may occasionally wash ashore, with conditions influenced by weather patterns and ocean currents.</p>

</div></div></div></div></div><div class="w-tabs-section" id="z18f"><button type="button" class="w-tabs-section-header" aria-controls="content-z18f" aria-expanded="false"><div class="w-tabs-section-title">House Rules</div><div class="w-tabs-section-control"></div></button><div  class="w-tabs-section-content us_custom_4c77c721" id="content-z18f"><div class="w-tabs-section-content-h i-cf"><div class="wpb_text_column"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><h3>House Rules</h3>
</div></div><section class="l-section wpb_row height_auto width_full"><div class="l-section-h i-cf"><div class="g-cols vc_row via_flex valign_top type_default stacking_default"><div class="vc_col-sm-12 wpb_column vc_column_container"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div class="wpb_raw_code wpb_raw_html wpb_content_element us_custom_909b2fd0" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<ul>
 	<li>Smoking, including E-cigarettes and Shisha Pipes, is strictly prohibited inside the property. Any breach of this rule will result in an immediate request for guests to vacate the villa without a refund. A penalty fee of $2,000 will also be charged for deep cleaning and shampoo of all soft furnishings.</li>
 	<li>Hosting parties and events on the premises is strictly prohibited and will result in eviction.</li>
 	<li>The Guest is not permitted to move or remove any furniture on the property. This includes indoor &amp; outdoor sofa cushions, which are to remain fixed to the furniture.</li>
 	<li>To ensure a comfortable stay, Lessee is encouraged to keep sliding doors closed to prevent bugs from entering the Villa.</li>
 	<li>The Guest is reminded to use only plastic cups and dishes around the pool deck and outdoor dining area.</li>
 	<li>We are located in a residential community and, although this is a holiday destination, it's home to many people. As such we ask that you respect their privacy and their right to a peaceful existence! Specifically, between the hours of 10pm and 8am noise should be kept to respectful levels.</li>
 	<li>Due to the septic system, the Guest must only flush toilet paper. Sanitary wipes and female products should not be flushed to prevent plumbing issues.</li>
 	<li>For emergency services (ambulance, police, fire) please immediately call 911.
<ul>
 	<li>Do not delay if you feel an emergency situation has arisen. State your location as the address on the front page of this guidebook.</li>

 	<li>In case of a fire, find the nearest exit point as quickly as possible. Ensure that all persons are accounted for.</li>
 	<li>Dial 911 and ask for ‘FIRE’.</li>
 	<li>State your location (see the front page of this book).</li>
 	<li>Do not attempt to re-enter the building until a Fire Officer states that it is safe to do so.</li>
 	<li>Please also notify the Property Manager</li>
</ul></li></ul>
		</div>
	</div>
</div></div></div></div></div></section>

The villas were beautiful and comfortably housed our group of 7. The one caveat I would say is that the home is a bit older than it seems at first glance and the villas doesn’t actually have private beach access, it’s shared amongst the complex but overall we loved it.</p><details class="guesty-review-categories"><summary>Rating details</summary><dl><div><dt>Cleanliness</dt><dd>5.0</dd></div><div><dt>Accuracy</dt><dd>4.0</dd></div><div><dt>Checkin</dt><dd>4.0</dd></div><div><dt>Communication</dt><dd>4.0</dd></div><div><dt>Location</dt><dd>4.0</dd></div><div><dt>Value</dt><dd>4.0</dd></div></dl></details></article><article class="guesty-review-card"><time datetime="2026-04-15">April 2026</time><p class="guesty-review-text">My family had a wonderful vacation at Bora Villa. The villa was immaculate and the layout was perfect for small children. Having our living spaces located on the second floor gave me peace of mind in regards to pool safety. The host was very responsive and helped us secure two cribs, high chairs and baby gates for our stay. The beach walk was very doable since we didn’t have to lug chairs and umbrellas. There is a grocery store nearby so you have the option to cook in or go out to restaurants 10-14 min away. At one point our oven wouldn’t work and the host replaced the entire oven within an hour. We would absolutely return to Bora Villa again and would recommend to all.</p><details class="guesty-review-categories"><summary>Rating details</summary><dl><div><dt>Cleanliness</dt><dd>5.0</dd></div><div><dt>Accuracy</dt><dd>5.0</dd></div><div><dt>Checkin</dt><dd>5.0</dd></div><div><dt>Communication</dt><dd>5.0</dd></div><div><dt>Location</dt><dd>5.0</dd></div><div><dt>Value</dt><dd>5.0</dd></div></dl></details></article><article class="guesty-review-card"><time datetime="2026-01-19">January 2026</time><p class="guesty-review-text">Beautiful Villa! The first day the house manager came to see us, very kind staff. Had to ask for linens for the pull outs but they took care of it right away! Great space for a girls trip, everyone was happy with the accommodations. There is not a shower on the floor with the two pull out beds, so who ever uses those rooms will have to share showers with one of the en suite rooms, which was not bad at all. Beautiful location, it was also a little distance to the beach, but walkable. Very quiet peaceful area in the mornings. <br />
